# Purpose
Defines common map error codes, map flags, and a small iterator structure used by map-related code in `fd_util`. The file also declares [`fd_map_strerror`](<#fd_map_strerror>), which returns a string for a map error code. The header guard prevents multiple inclusion, and the included `fd_util_base.h` supplies shared utility types and macros such as `ulong` and the function prototype markers.
